sect3.title: Using "namespace" as a class constant name
sect3.simpara: Using namespace as a class constant name is deprecated.

sect3.title: Returning from a finally block
sect3.simpara: Using the return statement in a finally block is now deprecated.

sect3.title: Nullable return type for __debugInfo()
sect3.simpara: Specifying a return type of arraynull for __debugInfo() is now deprecated. Specify array instead.

sect3.title: Returning values from __construct() and __destruct()
sect3.simpara: Returning values from __construct() and __destruct() is now deprecated.
Making __construct() and __destruct() a generator is now deprecated.

sect3.title: Naming a function readonly
sect3.simpara: Naming a function readonly is now deprecated.

sect3.title: Third argument to define()
sect3.simpara: Passing a third argument (case_insensitive) to define is now deprecated.

sect3.title: is_a() and is_subclass_of() with a string when allow_string is false
sect3.simpara: Calling is_a or is_subclass_of with a string as the first argument when allow_string is &false; is now deprecated.

sect3.title: metaphone()
sect3.simpara: The metaphone function is deprecated. Use a userland phonetic matching library instead.

sect3.title: More than 16 filters in a php://filter URL
sect3.simpara: Using more than 16 filters in a php://filter URL without configuring the filter.max_filter_count stream context option now emits an E_DEPRECATED warning. Use stream_filter_append or configure this option explicitly.

sect3.title: Passing objects to array_walk(), array_walk_recursive(), and http_build_query()
sect3.simpara: Passing an object to array_walk and array_walk_recursive is now deprecated. Use get_object_vars on the object instead.

Passing an object as the data argument to http_build_query is now deprecated. The interpretation of object values within data as arrays is also deprecated. Convert objects to arrays with get_object_vars before calling the function.

sect3.title: is_double(), is_long(), is_integer(), and doubleval()
sect3.simpara: The is_double function is now deprecated. Use is_float instead.
The is_long and is_integer functions are now deprecated. Use is_int instead.
The doubleval function is now deprecated. Use floatval instead.

sect3.title: strcoll() and SORT_LOCALE_STRING
sect3.simpara: The strcoll function is now deprecated. Use Collator::compare instead.
sect3.para:
The SORT_LOCALE_STRING constant for the family of sort functions is now deprecated. Use one of the following methods instead:
Collator::sort Collator::asort Collator::sortWithSortKeys

sect2.title: Bzip2
sect2.simpara: Passing an object as the parameters of the bzip2.compress and bzip2.decompress stream filters is now deprecated. Use get_object_vars on the object instead.

sect2.title: GMP
sect2.simpara: The shift (<<, >>) and exponentiation (**) operators on GMP objects now emit a deprecation warning when converting a float right operand to int loses precision.

sect2.title: MBString
sect2.simpara: The mbregex functions (mb_ereg and related functions) have been deprecated, because the underlying Oniguruma library is no longer maintained.
Passing objects to mb_convert_variables is now deprecated.

sect2.title: MySQLi
sect2.simpara: The mysqli_get_charset function and mysqli::get_charset method are now deprecated.
The mysqli_stmt_init function, mysqli::stmt_init method, and calling the mysqli_stmt::__construct constructor without providing the query parameter are now deprecated.

sect2.title: Reflection
sect2.simpara: Calling ReflectionProperty::setValue or ReflectionProperty::setRawValue with an object that is not an instance of the class on which the property was declared is now deprecated.
Calling ReflectionMethod::invoke or ReflectionMethod::invokeArgs with an object and a static method is now deprecated.

sect2.title: Session
sect2.simpara: Passing an object that does not implement the SessionIdInterface::create_sid and SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface::validateId methods to session_set_save_handler is now deprecated.

A deprecation is now emitted when implementing SessionHandlerInterface on a class which doesn't define the create_sid() or validateId() methods, as those will be moved from SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface and SessionIdInterface to SessionHandlerInterface.

sect2.title: SPL
sect2.simpara: The spl_classes function is now deprecated. Use ReflectionExtension::getClassNames instead.
The spl_object_hash function is now deprecated. Use spl_object_id instead.
sect2.para:
The following ArrayIterator methods are now deprecated:
ArrayIterator::getFlags ArrayIterator::setFlags ArrayIterator::asort ArrayIterator::ksort ArrayIterator::uasort ArrayIterator::uksort ArrayIterator::natsort ArrayIterator::natcasesort ArrayIterator::unserialize ArrayIterator::serialize

The following SplFileObject methods are now deprecated:
SplFileObject::fgetcsv SplFileObject::fputcsv SplFileObject::setCsvControl SplFileObject::getCsvControl

sect2.title: Zlib
sect2.simpara: Passing an object as the parameters of the zlib.deflate and zlib.inflate stream filters is now deprecated. Use get_object_vars on the object instead.
Passing an object as the options argument to deflate_init and inflate_init is now deprecated. Use get_object_vars on the object instead.
